name: Video Hash Analysis
algorithm: Video Hash Analysis — Statistical Pattern Analyzer
mechanism:
This method uses perceptual video hashing for forensic analysis:

1. **知覚的Hash計算**: A perceptual hash is computed per frame using established algorithms (pHash, dHash, wavelet hash). The hash captures the perceptual content summary — robust to minor modifications but sensitive to content changes.

2. **時間的Hash安定性**: Frame-to-frame hash changes are tracked. Natural video shows smooth hash evolution. The method detects anomalous hash transitions — sudden hash changes without corresponding visual scene changes, or hash stability during what should be content changes (freeze-frame manipulation).

3. **KnownContentマッチング**: Frame hashes are optionally compared against databases of known deepfake content or original source material. Hash matching can identify specific deepfake videos or trace the source footage used in a face swap.

4. **Hash-BasedTampering検出**: The ratio of frame-to-frame hash distance to visual change magnitude is analyzed. Manipulated frames may show hash distances disproportionate to the apparent visual change — indicating content modification below the perceptual threshold but detectable in the hash space.

5. **Multi-解像度Hashing**: Hashes computed at multiple resolutions capture changes at different spatial scales. Face-swap deepfakes may produce normal hashes at coarse resolution (overall structure preserved) but anomalous hashes at fine resolution (detail-level generation artifacts), creating a resolution-dependent hash signature.
parameters:
分析タイプ: 統計
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through 動画 hash analysis analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
